notes.title: 200k!
notes.content:
[h1]200,000 Wishlists! [/h1][p](I'm late writing this, its now 220,000 almost but yeah, shhhh. )[/p][p]
Felt like only yesterday that we were celebrating 100k but yeah we are at the double! 

Everyone. 
Thank you so much. 
I've been utterly blown away and humbled by you all. 

The ONL gamescom showing was such a huge success, ive received so many amazing messages of encouragement and it's reinforced why I love this gig so much. 

I was supposed to go but United Airlines struck again and delayed by flight by 5 hours because it rained for 15 minutes (I wish i was kidding). We got into the air and landed 10 minutes after my connection had taken off, the next flight out would have gotten me into Cologne, Germany after the showcase had started. So instead we got on a flight home the next day and watched it from the living room TV. My wife and I looking at each in disbelief when the trailer came on the screen.

If i had been in the hall, it would have looked like this: [/p][previewyoutube="xFM0HsV5cQc;full"][/previewyoutube][p] With all said and done, the game gained about 75k wishlists throughout gamescom. 

Wishlists only count when the game is done though. 
So onwards.

As always ill be on twitch on Tuesday--> Thursday working on the game if you want to drop by. A new DevLog will be out next month on youtube and the game will continue on. 

Once again, I appreciate you all.
Vin

//HILLFORT GAMES[/p]

notes.title: Devlog Nov 24'
notes.content:
Hey Guys, 

[h1]TL;DR:[/h1] 
Demo has been extended to be a little bigger. I released a new game (TEN BELLS) to help support development. I've started streaming development on https://www.twitch.tv/hillfortgames . I stream on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Fridays. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3044030/Ten_Bells/


[h1]Updates[/h1]

It's been a little bit since my last update, so let's get straight to the good stuff. 

LONG GONE is coming along really well. In Feb I promised a demo and that's still on track. Its going to include the now infamous front yard and a chunk of the first house that involves a few puzzles to play and get a good feel of the game. 

Mechanics are pretty good and done and art is coming in for them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310786/358934a62469b8166fc0446763c5138f80857ae5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310786/763c91bf7e52520ea4e1b616b65d02c3bac6f9d9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310786/8a8a5742da9ba0c9d2e456e0bc974b62cce0f788.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310786/a1a39b82afa3b16e7c371c64f0d295fd7e5c6b6e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Why is this game taking so long?[/h1]

Honestly, its not. It's just that life has gotten in the way for me to really focus on it. In Feb i went into a little bit of detail about immigration stuff but things got a little hairy after that Dev log. This is the short and end of it: The job i had moved to the states laid me off within months of arriving and didnt pay my last paycheck for 6 months and then my Mother passed away so i had to travel home as well as some medical issues at home in the states which wiped out my remaining savings. 

Being in a little bit of financial ruin from traveling back and forth from the UK to the USA, I made the difficult choice to pause development on LONG GONE to focus on a much smaller game to earn some money to support me in making LONG GONE. I along with the help of Acrylic Pixel released TEN BELLS in August after a short 3.5 month dev time. The game was very well received at 98% positive ratings over 130 reviews but because of Steam's algorithm not letting many games without wishlists before release rise to the top, its been a bit of a slow roll out, but hoping it gets there. Even Yahtzee liked it.

You can check out TEN BELLS here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3044030/Ten_Bells/

With Ten Bells out, i'm now on LONG GONE as full time as i can be. Since i announced a Demo, i've had a few comments on "I hope its more than that front yard." While the front yard has a pretty meaty puzzle, i think people are right; I can make it more than that so i've decided to add a some of the first house too which is what you can see in the screenshots above. In the past few weeks ive been streaming development on twitch which has been going pretty good so far! 

https://www.twitch.tv/hillfortgames 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310786/ec0010289f39fe84df5ac0fc95c840c31a7eff27.png[/img]

In the past few weeks on twitch i've:

[list]
[*] Grey boxed the first house in more detail
[*] Populated foliage
[*] Added camera zones for a more cinematic look to the game overall
[*] added a new zombie
[*] lighting overhauls to have bounce and directional light
[*] added more lore
[*] added a bunch of items
[*] worked on some animations
[*] and more...
[/list]

Feel free to join me if you're into games development. We've got a great little community going so far and the game is progressing really well. 

If you're just excited for the demo and want to go in blind then be sure to check if you're wishlisted so you can be alerted when the demo will be in your hands in the coming months. 

Onwards!

notes.title: It's been a while!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310786/aa077ee7650b3c49bafa0d5efd4846f97ab2e2f9.png"][/img] 
It's been quite a couple of years since I "announced" Long Gone was in early development so let's talk about changes in the game and what's been happening.   In 2022 when I announced the game for steam, I posted the very early prototype to see if anyone was interested in the game before I progressed onto a vertical slice, i was absolutely blown away by the support and today the game is at almost 23000 wishlists. I've been posting small updates on TikTok which has helped the game go viral a couple of times 
too. Its been amazing to see the support of my little game as a soloDev!  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310786/6e914c051f003aa145045737ee6508823ed8c3cd.png"][/img]

In 2022, I was living in Canada, working as a Senior Concept Artist at a AAA studio, I applied for my US via and it ended up taking 19 months to process. My visa expired in Canada so i needed to return home to the UK while my US visa was processing. This meant i was on the road and busy with Freelance work on other games so progress on Long Gone was slow because i was working off a laptop on an ironing board (im not kidding). 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310786/a13ff74d11b98e4fd82bbd3eafe1188072dbbc2a.png"][/img]
In October of 2023 I got into the US and I'm back with my Wife, I have a full office again and so the project is FULL [i]STEAM[/i] AHEAD. 

...get it. Because [i]Steam[/i]. ANYWAY.

So in the past couple of months i've finished the vertical slice, most of the game is greyboxed and the game is almost in Alpha. Alpha means that a game's mechanics are all coded and working in the game which means I'm now just making content. I've found a couple of artists to start helping me out in the ramp up to the beta milestone this summer but I'm not 100% sure when the game will be finished.

[/p][h1]Updates[/h1][p]
So lets talk about some changes to the game from the last time you saw it here on steam. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310786/8675beb4d0fa1053afd43d31e5aed8a344203964.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310786/bdeb9bae544ebd47f1fe44dee404eb14a5889cee.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310786/8c2eee7a195e628eb29965a4253b42fcfa81e627.png"][/img]

[/p][list][*][p] New Artwork for the front yard Demo assets (BG, porch, house, etc.)
[/p][/*][*][p] Yard "Get in the house" Demo puzzles are complete and playable.
[/p][/*][*][p] New Grass Shader
[/p][/*][*][p] Interactive "Large" items Complete (Draws, boxes etc.)
[/p][/*][*][p] Foliage system and art complete (still needs animation)
[/p][/*][*][p] Bag UX and reading overhauled and fully functioning
[/p][/*][*][p] Pick up and Drop system is complete
[/p][/*][*][p] Cutscene Triggering is complete
[/p][/*][*][p] Combining Items Complete
[/p][/*][*][p] Item Use and Fail states complete
[/p][/*][*][p] Dialogue System Complete
[/p][/*][*][p] Keys and Unlockable items Complete
[/p][/*][*][p] Character speed slowed down
[/p][/*][*][p] Mouth Animation when the dude talks
[/p][/*][*][p] Story outline is complete
[/p][/*][*][p] So...so much more.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310786/fd36728353df3fc4fff7a78acebce0fc6270a172.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310786/ff8433ad5e7505a85462f3ed8db2a13a8ac3108a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310786/2bf1ada9155d946d1599ba1c6f263716d07ad144.png"][/img]
[/p][h1]More devs and Patreon[/h1][p]
I've had some concern from fans excited for the game that as a Solo-dev, ill not be able to make the game in a timely manor. While ive only just got back into the flow of making the game, ive also taken this on board and im in the process of hiring a couple of people to help me out on the game's visuals as that is the biggest time-sink at the moment. This isnt cheap though, so if youre interested in supporting the game then you can find Hillfort Games on PATREON [url="https://www.patreon.com/HillfortGames"]https://www.patreon.com/HillfortGames[/url] 

[/p][h1]Next?[/h1][p]
A playable Demo. Even though ive tried in the description of the store page to explain the game, people still think its a survival game. Gather the food and ammo, kill all the Zombies etc. While there is some of that; its not really the game. To to squash ambiguity, the game will be playable for you all to find out. I'm hoping the demo may attract finances for the game to thrive too. The demo will be from the vertical slice which is about just getting into the house from the front yard. I know you guys are sick of that yard, but its the most art-complete section i have right now.

[/p][h1]“Is the whole game just that yard?!”[/h1][p]
Of course not. At the very beginning of the project, I created that front yard, which you have all seen and probably got sick of by now, and this is commonly referred to as a vertical slice. Vertical slices are there to test the game can work as a product as a semi-polished piece, because that was successful by the amazing reaction from all of you guys, I went into production. While in production, I have a mantra; ”it has to work before it looks pretty”. Unfortunately all the work that isn’t pretty is ugly. Like…. Really ugly. Grey boxes, the items are cubes, animations are missing; but it’s working! This is what ive been focused on. This is why nothing has really been shown because whenever I do, it tanks in views, nobody cares, people just want the pretty stuff which I get it. I want to make the pretty stuff too! 

Until next time!


[/p]
